model: CSF (Brackbill 1992 / Adami 2010); A_surf mixed-only immiscibility repulsion; B_surf unused
annulus_mask: r in [R+2.5h, R+4h], y-band clear of walls (c~=0)
note: 2D dimensionless; CSF sigma is a DIRECT model parameter - the Laplace law dP = sigma/R is a VERIFICATION: the slope of dP vs 1/R should equal sigma_input. sigma_eff ~ 0.95-0.99 sigma_input after the velocity-Verlet factor-2 fix (2026-08-14); the residual few-% is a finite h/R discretization effect (converges to 1.0 as h/R -> 0), NOT a band-split. Use sigma_eff (mean of per-radius dP*R) for the shear sweep's capillary number. dP = P_core - P_annulus averaged after 4x t_char; same measurement as sph.validate_laplace.
